verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own trading and settlement module lets participants submit market orders online with 'sell to cover', 'sell all' or 'hold all' choices. It tracks those orders until the money lands, and pays out via Airwallex. These are exercise-style settlement choices, but the evidence never explicitly describes an employee option-exercise flow. missing for 10: explicit online option exercise workflow, employee payment of exercise price, automated share issuance on exercise, confirmation that no paper forms are needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
